projects.title: Dance Dance Evolution
projects.description:
DDE is a browser-based version of the popular arcade game Dance Dance Revolution. It is built using the MEAN stack and does not require any third-party plugins.
• Makes extensive use of the Tone.js and GSAP libraries for song playback and synchronized arrow animations, respectively
• Allows users to upload and play their own favorite songs; fully compatible with stepchart files designed for the desktop game StepMania
• Can be played using a gamepad or with custom key bindings

projects.title: Socket Jam
projects.description: Socket Jam is a collaborative environment in which users can participate in musical performances over the Internet in real time. It supports multiple instrument sounds including piano, acoustic guitar, drums, and supersaw.
